summary: Osisko Gold Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release reporting its Q2 2026 financial results. The release covers cash position, convertible notes offering financing, project construction updates at Cariboo, operational drilling results, corporate appointments, and name change to Osisko Gold Group Inc. No special-situation event is present; this is a routine earnings and operational update with standard disclosures. The filing includes no M&A activity, activist campaigns, tender offers, or other transformative corporate actions. It describes ordinary business progress and management additions, not a forced departure. The convertible notes offering was disclosed previously and does not constitute a rights offering or issuer tender. The content is a standard quarterly report, so the appropriate classification is None.
